title: Musical nationalism
description: Use of musical ideas that are identified with a specific country
extract: Musical nationalism refers to the use of musical ideas or motifs that are identified with a specific country, region, or ethnicity, such as folk tunes and melodies, rhythms, and harmonies inspired by them.
